source_full: So he sent a message by one of his pages that the merchant was to come to see him the next day, and bring with him a coat made of stone, now the poor man had been very sad since he got home the evening before, for though his daughters had promised that nothing should happen while he was away, He had found the two elder ones married without asking his leave. And now there was this fresh misfortune, For how was he to make a coat of stone?
